definitions.explanation: A person who studies human history and prehistory through the excavation and analysis of artifacts, structures, and other physical remains.

examples.japanese: {考古学者|こうこがくしゃ}が{古|ふる}い{土器|どき}を{発見|はっけん}した。
{彼|かれ}は{有名|ゆうめい}な{考古学者|こうこがくしゃ}だ。
{考古学者|こうこがくしゃ}たちは{遺跡|いせき}の{発掘|はっくつ}{調査|ちょうさ}を{続|つづ}けている。
examples.english: The archaeologists continue their excavation research at the ruins.

notes:
{考古学者|こうこがくしゃ} means archaeologist. The word combines {考古学|こうこがく} (archaeology) with {者|しゃ} (person/practitioner).

FORMS:
{考古|こうこ} (examining the old) + {学|がく} (study) + {者|しゃ} (person)

RELATED WORDS:
- {考古学|こうこがく}: archaeology
- {発掘|はっくつ}: excavation
- {遺跡|いせき}: ruins, archaeological site
- {遺物|いぶつ}: artifact, relic
- {土器|どき}: earthenware, pottery

SIMILAR {学者|がくしゃ} COMPOUNDS:
- {歴史学者|れきしがくしゃ}: historian
- {科学者|かがくしゃ}: scientist
- {言語学者|げんごがくしゃ}: linguist
